sahneler.metin: A compact car became the focus of America's first great car safety fight.
Crashes blamed on sudden oversteer led to lawsuits and a best-selling book.
The early Corvair used swing-axle rear suspension.
In hard turns, a rear wheel could tuck under.
Tyre pressures had to be kept exactly right.
Later tests found it no worse than rivals.
But the debate changed the law.
The US created federal auto safety standards soon after.
